_source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 record of NCT07465926 as posted in the 2026-11-15 snapshot (re-fetched 2026-11-18): identification, enrollment and the baseline module's groups, denominators and four of its eleven measures (Age, Sex/Gender, Ethnicity, Race/Ethnicity), verbatim.

baselineCharacteristicsModule.populationDescription: Baseline characteristics are presented for each prespecified pairwise propensity score-matched cohort. For each row, counts are reported only for the two arms that constitute that comparison; the remaining columns are presented as 0 because those participants are outside the matched cohort being characterized in that row.

groups.title: GLP-1 RA With SGLT2i Add-On (Comparison 1)
groups.description: Adults with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic stage 2-3 who initiated a GLP-1 receptor agonist as base therapy and were classified as having SGLT2 inhibitor add-on treatment within 90 days during the initial treatment assessment period. This group represents the propensity score-matched cohort for Comparison 1.

groups.title: GLP-1 RA With DPP-4i/SU Add-On (Comparison 1)
groups.description: Adults with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic stage 2-3 who initiated a GLP-1 receptor agonist as base therapy and were classified as having DPP-4 inhibitor or sulfonylurea add-on treatment within 90 days during the initial treatment assessment period. This group represents the propensity score-matched cohort for Comparison 1.

groups.title: GLP-1 RA With SGLT2i Add-On (Comparison 2)
groups.description: Adults with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic stage 2-3 who initiated a GLP-1 receptor agonist as base therapy and were classified as having SGLT2 inhibitor add-on treatment within 90 days during the initial treatment assessment period. This group represents the propensity score-matched cohort for Comparison 2.

groups.title: GLP-1 RA Only (No Early Add-On) (Comparison 2)
groups.description: Adults with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic stage 2-3 who initiated a GLP-1 receptor agonist as base therapy and did not receive early add-on treatment within 90 days during the initial treatment assessment period. This group represents the propensity score-matched cohort for Comparison 2.

groups.title: SGLT2i With GLP-1 RA Add-On (Comparison 3)
groups.description: Adults with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic stage 2-3 who initiated an SGLT2 inhibitor as base therapy and were classified as having GLP-1 receptor agonist add-on treatment within 90 days during the initial treatment assessment period. This group represents the propensity score-matched cohort for Comparison 3.

groups.description: Adults with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic stage 2-3 who initiated an SGLT2 inhibitor as base therapy and were classified as having DPP-4 inhibitor or sulfonylurea add-on treatment within 90 days during the initial treatment assessment period. This group represents the propensity score-matched cohort for Comparison 3.

groups.title: SGLT2i With GLP-1 RA Add-On (Comparison 4)
groups.description: Adults with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic stage 2-3 who initiated an SGLT2 inhibitor as base therapy and were classified as having GLP-1 receptor agonist add-on treatment within 90 days during the initial treatment assessment period. This group represents the propensity score-matched cohort for Comparison 4.

This group represents the propensity score-matched cohort for Comparison 4.

measures.title: Age, Customized
measures.populationDescription: Data are reported separately for each prespecified pairwise propensity score-matched cohort. For each row, counts are reported only for the two arms in that comparison; remaining columns are 0 because those participants are outside the matched cohort. Cohort eligibility required age ≥20 years; participants not resolved into the displayed age strata are reported under "Other age category" so counts sum to the analyzed population.

measures.title: Sex/Gender, Customized
measures.populationDescription: Data are reported separately for each prespecified pairwise propensity score-matched cohort. For each row, counts are reported only for the two arms in that comparison; remaining columns are 0 because those participants are outside the matched cohort. Participants not resolved into the displayed sex/gender strata are reported under "Unknown or Not Reported" so counts sum to the analyzed population.

measures.title: Ethnicity (NIH/OMB)
measures.populationDescription: Data are reported separately for each prespecified pairwise propensity score-matched cohort. For each comparison-specific row, counts are reported only for the two arms that constitute that comparison; the remaining columns are presented as 0 because those participants are outside the matched cohort being characterized in that row.

measures.title: Race/Ethnicity, Customized
measures.populationDescription: Data are reported separately for each prespecified pairwise propensity score-matched cohort. For each row, counts are reported only for the two arms in that comparison; remaining columns are 0 because those participants are outside the matched cohort. Participants not in the listed race strata, including small race groups not shown separately and records without a resolved race category, are reported under "Other, Unknown, or Not Reported" so counts sum to the analyzed population.
